firstPlayerRule: The group chooses someone to start, then takes turns clockwise.
houseFallback: If you want a quick way to choose, pick a player randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The rulebook leaves the choice to the players; it does not prescribe a personal characteristic or a random draw.
